title: Bulk change count does not count the cores that change with their parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BCORE-01) is tracked at {Location-A}, is active and has a Core Charge (for example $25.00), so it has a core.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BCORE-02) is tracked at {Location-A}, is active and has a Core Charge (for example $25.00), so it has a core.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BCORE-0), so one search lists them together.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search the shared start (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BCORE-0).
  2. Open the ⋮ actions menu and click "Deactivate parts".
  3. Tick {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
  4. Click "Deactivate" in the bulk bar.
  5. Click "Deactivate" in the confirmation.
  6. Read the message at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The bulk bar reads 2 selected.
  • Step 5: {Part-A} and {Part-B} leave the Active tab without a page reload.
  • Step 6: A green message reads "2 parts updated.": the 2 ticked parts are counted and their 2 cores are not (2 ticked, not 2 + 2 = 4).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R12, S10-R12a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.5 (Done: "2 parts updated."), 13 Oct copy. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 9): "2 parts updated.", cores are not counted. SV-10823 acceptance criteria. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R12: “After a bulk change, the system shows how many parts changed and how many failed.”
  • S10-R12a: “The counts include only the parts the user selected. A core that changes with its part is not counted, so changing 2 parts that both have a core reads "2 parts updated."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one) | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • SV-10823 acceptance criteria: “Given two parts that both have a core, when they are deactivated in bulk, then the message reads "2 parts updated."”
